run_eval_cli: run the eval module from the command line with a config file path argument
run_do_eval: run evaluation on a trained model checkpoint using a config schema and optional evaluator
run_do_eval_and_report_stats: run evaluation and yield per-bucket and per-edge-path stats as a generator
review_RankingEvaluator_process_one_batc: review the RankingEvaluator class _process_one_batch method that computes ranking metrics like MRR and hits at K
review_RankingEvaluator_adjust_scores: review the RankingEvaluator _adjust_scores hook method for subclass filtering of true edges
